lines.en: Why doesn't Aunt Jennifer tell anyone how old she is?
lines.cn: 为什么詹妮弗阿姨从不告诉别人她的真实年龄呢？

lines.en: My aunt Jennifer is an actress.
lines.cn: 我的阿姨詹妮弗是一名演员。

lines.en: She must be at least thirty-five years old.
lines.cn: 她至少有 thirty-five 岁了。

lines.en: In spite of this, she often appears on the stage as a young girl.
lines.cn: 尽管如此，她仍然经常以年轻女孩的形象出现在舞台上。

lines.en: Jennifer will have to take part in a new play soon.
lines.cn: 詹妮弗很快将不得不参加一部新的戏剧演出。

lines.en: This time, she will be a girl of seventeen.
lines.cn: 这一次，她将是一个十七岁的女孩。

lines.en: In the play, she must appear in a bright red dress and long black stockings.
lines.cn: 在剧中，她必须穿着一件亮红色的连衣裙和一双长长的黑色长袜出场。

lines.en: she had to wear short socks and a bright, orange-coloured dress.
lines.cn: 她不得不穿短袜和一条鲜艳的橙色连衣裙。

lines.en: If anyone ever asks her how old she is,
she always answers, 'Darling, it must be terrible to be grown up!'
lines.cn: 她总是回答：“亲爱的，长大一定很可怕吧！”
